https://www.playstation.com/en-in/suppor.visible_text: How to request a refund for a purchase on PlayStation Store Support Home PlayStation Status Account & Security PS Store & Refunds Subscriptions Games Hardware & Repairs Online Safety Connectivity PC How to request a refund for a purchase on PlayStation Store Find out if you're eligible for a PlayStation®Store refund and how to request a refund on PlayStation Store purchases. Check refund eligibility Purchase type Refund FAQ Request refund Depending on the type of product, you may be able to request a refund if you’ve changed your mind about a PlayStation Store purchase. In addition to the below, you may have additional rights under applicable local law, such as if your content is faulty. Nothing in the below limits or replaces any such rights under local law. How to request a refund on a PlayStation Store purchase Open your Transaction History and select an eligible transaction . How to check transaction history Select Request Refund and follow the on-screen instructions. If you’re still having issues, please contact PlayStation Support. Contact PlayStation Support How to check the refund eligibility of your PlayStation Store purchase Select your purchase type to check your refund eligibility. Cancellation policy PlayStation terms of service PlayStation Store purchase type Games, DLC Subscriptions Pre-orders Games and DLCs Full games, downloadable content (DLC) and season passes fall under this category. All criteria in the checklist below must be satisfied to be eligible for a refund unless the content is faulty. Games and DLCs refund checklist Content has not been downloaded or streamed. ✓ Refund request has been made within 14 days of the purchase. ✓ Check purchase date If your game purchase is eligible for a refund, you can request a refund. In-game consumables In-game consumables Items such as virtual currencies (e.g. EA FC Coins, V Bucks in Fortnite or Shark Cards in GTA V), add-ons (such as skins, bonus levels or emotes), XP boosts or other items that are depleted during gameplay fall under this category. All criteria in the checklist below must be satisfied to be eligible for a refund unless the content is faulty. In-game consumables refund checklist Refund request has been made within 14 days of the purchase. ✓ Content has been purchased in PlayStation Store.* ✓ Game has not been launched after purchase. ✓ *When you purchase in-game consumables outside of gameplay, they are delivered to you when you next launch the game. If you purchase in-game consumables during gameplay, they are delivered to you immediately. Check purchase date Subscriptions A subscription includes any purchase of a service with recurring fees from PlayStation Store, such as PlayStation®Plus. All criteria in the checklist below must be satisfied to be eligible for a refund. Subscriptions refund checklist Refund request has been made within 14 days from signing up.* ✓ Refund request is for your first payment, not a recurring fee. ✓ *This is based on the agreement and acknowledgement you made at the time of purchasing your subscription. If you take advantage of a free trial when you sign up, your 14-day cancellation period includes any time included in your free trial. For example, if you sign up for a free trial which lasts 7 days and you are charged for the subscription at the end of the trial, you only have a further 7 days after your payment to cancel. Check purchase date If you're eligible for a refund, but you've started using your subscription (for PlayStation Plus this might include: playing online, downloading monthly games or using cloud storage) we may reduce your refund based on your use of the subscription. You can check the guide below to learn how to stop future payments at any time. Your subscription will continue until the next payment is due, at which point it will end. Cancel subscription Pre-orders A pre-order refers to any purchase of content from PlayStation Store before its release date. Pre-ordered more than 14 days before the release date All criteria in the checklist below must be satisfied to be eligible for a refund unless the content is faulty. Pre-order refund checklist Refund request has been made before the release date. ✓ Main part of the content has not been downloaded or preloaded. ✓ If your pre-order includes immediately accessible extra content (for example, pre-order bonus content) and you have not started to download the main part of your pre-order, the extra content stops working if you cancel your pre-order. Pre-ordered less than 14 days before the release date If your purchase meets all criteria in the checklist below, you can request a refund at any time before the release date (if the release date has passed, within 14 days from purchase). If your purchase doesn’t meet all criteria, it isn’t eligible for a refund unless the content is faulty. Pre-order refund checklist Refund request has been made within 14 days from purchase. ✓ Main part of the content has not been downloaded or preloaded. ✓ If your pre-order includes immediately accessible extra content (for example, pre-order bonus content) and you have not started to download the main part of your pre-order, the extra content stops working if you cancel your pre-order. If your game purchase is eligible for a refund, you can request a refund. Frequently Asked Questions Having game issues? If you’re experiencing issues with your game or add-on, visit one of the guides below for troubleshooting steps. Can't download a game Game doesn't start Game crashes or freezes Add-on, DLC troubleshooting When can I receive my refund? You may receive your refund in 10 days. Where can I receive my refund? Where possible, refunds are issued to the payment method used to make the purchase. However, there may be some payment methods or instances where this may not be possible, such as purchases made using wallet fund vouchers. If for any reason we are unable to issue the refund to your original payment method, the amount is credited to your wallet instead. My refund hasn’t arrived, what can I do? If you’ve received a confirmation from us that you will be refunded and you haven’t received your refund, please check below. If your refund is payable to a payment method other than the wallet, check your wallet balance (as we may have been unable to refund to your original payment method) or contact your payment method provider for further assistance. If your refund is payable to your wallet, please contact us . Can I request a refund for wallet funds? You cannot cancel a wallet top-up. We seek your consent to top up your wallet immediately and acknowledgment that you understand you will not be able to cancel your top-up. Can I request a refund for an online ID change? You can revert to a previous online ID for free, but you can't obtain a refund for a purchase of a new online ID unless your purchase was faulty. Troubleshoot online ID issues Can I request a refund for voucher codes? As purchases of voucher codes are made outside of PlayStation Store, you need to contact the retailer that sold the voucher code to you for their refunds and cancellation policy. https://www.playstation.com/en-in/corpor.visible_text: About Us (India) About Sony Interactive Entertainment Who we are... Sony Interactive Entertainment pushes the boundaries of entertainment and innovation, starting from the launch of the original PlayStation in Japan in 1994. Today, we continue to deliver innovative and thrilling experiences to a global audience through our PlayStation line of products and services that include generation-defining hardware, pioneering network services, and award-winning games. Headquartered in San Mateo, California, with global functions in California, London, and Tokyo, and game development studios around the world as part of PlayStation Studios, we believe that the power of play is borderless. Sony Interactive Entertainment is a wholly owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation. For more information about our company, visit sonyinteractive.com . Our values As well as creating incredible gaming experiences, SIE is committed to building inclusive communities for our players and staff, as well as recognising the part we can play in reducing our products' environmental impact. Accessibility PlayStation® strives to create a gaming experience without barriers that fits the needs of players of all abilities. Read more PlayStation & the environment Find out what we're doing to reduce our environmental impact, and how our players can help. Read more Online safety, account security & privacy However you choose to play, PlayStation will always strive to make gaming welcoming, secure, and inclusive for everyone. Read more Diversity, equity & inclusivity Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) values diversity and strives to create a work environment in which all employees can be themselves, enabling them to reach their full potential. Read more PlayStation hardware & services Meet the current flagship products and services in the PlayStation family: PlayStation 5 Launched in 2020, PlayStation 5 introduced new innovations that have taken play to extraordinary new heights, including an ultra-fast SSD, Tempest 3D Audio technology, and a generation of games that harness the console's lightning speed and graphical capabilities to create incredible new experiences. (Vertical stand sold separately) DualSense wireless controller Every PS5 console comes complete with a DualSense wireless controller, which enhances play with an incredible sense of immersion thanks to innovative haptic feedback and trigger effects in compatible games. PlayStation VR2 PlayStation VR2 is the virtual reality companion to PS5, bringing ultra-immersive 4K HDR gameplay, intelligent eye tracking, and amazing new sensations from PlayStation VR2 Sense Technology built-in to the headset and the innovative new PS VR2 Sense controller. PlayStation Plus PlayStation Plus is our subscription service that offers hundreds of PS5, PS4 and classic PlayStation games in a choice of three membership plans that also include online multiplayer and a range of member-exclusive benefits. PlayStation Store PlayStation Store is our always-on digital store, stocking the world's largest and most comprehensive selection of downloadable PlayStation games for PS5, PS4 and PS VR2. You'll find PlayStation Store built in to our consoles, as well as on the web and via the PlayStation App. PlayStation Studios is our family of game development studios creating incredible gaming worlds for PlayStation consoles and, more recently, PC. Find out more PlayStation game franchises Discover some of the key gaming franchises available on PlayStation consoles. Horizon Developed by Guerrilla, the Horizon series presents a far-future version of Earth where tribal cultures exist in the shadow of the colossal, ferocious machines that rule over a world reclaimed by nature. Horizon Zero Dawn launched on PS4 in 2017, followed by Horizon Forbidden West on PS4 and PS5, and Horizon Call of the Mountain on PS VR2. God of War Santa Monica Studios' demigod protagonist Kratos first appeared on PlayStation 2 in 2005, wreaking a trail of vengeance through six games before resurfacing as a protective father to son Atreus in 2018's God of War on PS4. God of War Ragnarök, released on PS5 in 2022, is the 8th entry in Kratos' saga and became the fastest-selling PlayStation title of all time. Find out more The Last of Us Naughty Dog's The Last of Us debuted on PlayStation 3 with emotional storytelling, relatable characters, and intense action gameplay in a world ravaged by a deadly infection. The Last of Us Part II arrived on PS4 in 2020, while Part I was rebuilt for PS5 in 2022 and PC in 2023. Season one of a TV adaptation premiered in 2023, and season two is currently in development. Find out more Gran Turismo Polyphony Digital's Gran Turismo series debuted on the original PlayStation console in 1997 and continues to push the boundaries of what a driving simulator can be. The series touches every aspect of automotive culture, from incredibly detailed tracks and faithfully recreated high-performance cars to real-life racing in the Gran Turismo Academy, which has created more than a dozen professional drivers. Find out more Uncharted Naughty Dog's Uncharted series has led the way in cinematic action-adventure storytelling in video games, since its inception with Uncharted: Drake's Fortune on PS3. The series spans four games on PS3 and PS4, a spin-off title in Uncharted: The Lost Legacy on PS4, plus a collection of remastered titles for PS5. Find out more 30 years of PlayStation Join us as we celebrate 30 years of PlayStation with a series of special events, and look back at the consoles, games and greatest moments that brought play to life. Join the celebrations Explore our history Careers at Sony Interactive Entertainment SIE offers a diverse, inclusive culture where every one of our employees has room to grow. Search for vacancies at any of the PlayStation sites and take your career to the next level. See vacancies in your region Contact us Help and support If you need help and support with any PlayStation console, product or service, the best way to get assistance is via our dedicated support hub. Help & Support Social Media PlayStation regional offices Our regional headquarters worldwide are located at: Europe, Middle East, Africa & Australasia London office: 10 Great Marlborough Street, London W1F 7LP, United Kingdom. UK Company no: 03277793 UK VAT no: GB 760 9739 93 Americas Global headquarters: 2207 Bridgepointe Pkwy. San Mateo, CA 94404 USA Japan & Asia Japan offices: Sony City 1-7-1, Konan, Minato-ku, Tokyo, 108-0075 Japan Shibaura Crystal Shinagawa Konan 1-6-27, Konan, Minato-ku, Tokyo, 108-8270 Japan For press inquires, please submit a media inquiry form . About SIE Companies The full PlayStation experience is brought to you by a number of Sony Interactive Entertainment companies. If you live in Europe, Africa, Middle East, Oceania, India and Ukraine you may find yourself interacting with the following SIE companies when using our products and services: Sony Interactive Entertainment Europe Limited ("SIEE") SIEE operates www.playstation.com. SIEE also develops and publishes PlayStation related products and services, including PlayStation games, online services and distributes PlayStation hardware. SIEE is the parent company of the online retailer, Sony Interactive Entertainment Network Europe Limited. Registered address: 10 Great Marlborough Street London W1F 7LP United Kingdom UK Company no: 03277793 UK VAT no: GB 760 9739 93 Email: help@uk.playstation.com Sony Interactive Entertainment Network Europe Limited ("SIENE") SIENE operates PlayStation Network and the PlayStation Store. https://www.playstation.com/en-in/editor.visible_text: This month on PlayStation | PS4 and PS5 releases - September 2026 THIS SEPTEMBER ON PLAYSTATION Your guide to the month ahead on PS5, including new releases, in-depth features and expert guides. For surly anti-heroes Marvel's Wolverine In his fight for the future, Wolverine must team up with fellow mutants across the globe through locations like Canada, Japan, and the Marvel island nation of Madripoor. With the fate of humans and mutants hanging in the balance, Logan knows the world needs a hero; however, they’ll have to settle for Wolverine. Marvel's Wolverine releases on PlayStation 5 September 15. You'll love it if you liked: Marvel's Spider-Man 2 , Sifu Find out more For gothic horror lovers The Blood of Dawnwalker Bursting out of the crypt on September 4 , The Blood of Dawnwalker lets you decide what kind of vampire you want to be. Your actions will shape the world, but every quest pushes time forward and your enemies will have plans of their own. So think about your decisions: what’s more important, saving your family or draining all the blood from the village idiot who gave you the side eye? You'll love it if you liked: Kingdom Come Deliverance 2 , The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Find out more For thrilling sword fights Onimusha: Way of the Sword The real-life Miyamoto Musashi was a skilful, undefeated duelist. Historians disagree on whether he was slain by the demonic Genma and resurrected with the power of the Oni Gauntlet, but that’s the story Capcom are going with in Onimusha: Way of the Sword. Help Musashi on his quest to liberate a corrupted Edo-period Kyoto, and become the world’s greatest swordsman from September 4 . You'll love it if you liked: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice , Ghost of Yōtei Find out more For fans of psychological horror Silent Hill: Townfall If your recent dreams have been boringly pleasant, then Silent Hill: Townfall might be just what you need to induce a few nightmares when it arrives on September 24 . Get up close with the horrors of St. Amelia with the new first-person perspective, and use your portable CRTV to detect threats and investigate clues. Your decisions will shape the ending – but you’ll need to hold your nerve to get there. You'll love it if you liked: Silent Hill f , Resident Evil Requiem Find out more For fans of multiplayer base building Dune: Awakening If you can endure the sandstorms, outrun the sandworms and defeat all your enemies in combat, you’ll find that the planet of Arrakis is a pretty nice place to live. Dune: Awakening , arriving on September 22 , lets you explore this desert world alone or with friends. Will you conquer the harsh terrain, build a mighty fortress and earn a fortune, or just raid rival camps and be a general nuisance? You'll love it if you liked: ARK: Survival Evolved , Conan Exiles Find out more Meet the character CONTROL Resonant Who is Dylan Faden? Once fated to be the director of the Federal Bureau of Control, the powerful psychic Dylan Faden fell under the influence of a paranatural entity known as The Hiss. After causing a reality-altering incident, he was defeated by his sister Jesse, and locked away by the FBC. However, when a cosmic entity threatens to destroy Manhattan, Dylan is offered a chance to redeem himself. Continue Dylan’s story in CONTROL Resonant , available on September 24 . Watch trailer Find out more Your latest monthly games Grow your library and look forward to a selection of games refreshed every month. Available to download with any PlayStation Plus plan, and yours to keep for as long as you’re a member. Sniper Elite: Resistance Help the French Resistance thwart an insidious Nazi plot in a sandbox stealth shooter that can be played solo or with an ally in online co-op. Get this game MLB® The Show™ 26 Make your mark in the most immersive MLB® The Show yet, featuring refined pitching and batting controls, and a revamped Franchise experience. Get this game Wobbly Life Explore an open world of wobbly weirdness with up three friends, and earn a living through a range of honest jobs like firefighter, astronaut and disco dancer. Get this game Chained Echoes Bring peace to three warring kingdoms in a turn-based pixel art RPG set in a fantasy world where dragons are as common as piloted mech suits. Get this game Join the conversation Get the very latest news from PlayStation's social media channels. [{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"VideoObject","name":"Zombie Army VR - Release Date Trailer | PS VR2 Games","description":"Zombie Army VR is available to PRE-ORDER NOW on PlayStation VR2 and coming May 22nd 2025!
Zombie Hitler has been defeated, but the zombie hordes are still at large, and Europe remains in the throes of war. Following the story of Zombie Army, you return to the field as one of the Deadhunters, an elite squad fighting to end the apocalypse!
Fight your way through undead hordes near the bombed-out city of Nuremberg to help Captain Hermann Wolff, the Deadhunter’s legendary leader, find his scattered family, and fight to free Europe from the zombie apocalypse.
As you navigate the full-length, story-driven campaign alone or with an ally, you will have access to an arsenal of authentic World War II weaponry including sniper rifles, submachine guns, pistols, and more. 
VR also brings a new level of immersion to the nail-biting action of the Zombie Army series, and you will need to get to grips with using your hands to aim your rifle, dual-wield your side arm with a submachine gun, and master reloading drills. Keeping your head and staying cool as you face hordes of enemies (including Armoured Giants, Suiciders, Sniper Zombies, and more) will be crucial if you are to succeed!
The X-ray Kill Cam returns, allowing you to relive long-range kills in slow motion glory. 
Create the Deadhunter that fits your SLAYstyle. As you SLAY your way across a zombie-infested Europe, earn XP to level up your Deadhunter and use Weapon Upgrade kits to modify the range, accuracy, scope, and capacity of your weapons. 
Join up with a comrade to share ammo and medkits and compete to score the most creative executions and dismemberments.
Key features: 
• Spine-chilling campaign
• Authentic World War II weapons
• Player progression and weapon modification
• Series signature X-ray Kill Cam
• Slay alone or with a friend
